The XRD results confirmed that the as-cast microstructure primarily consisted of γ and γ’ phases across all alloy compositions, indicating that increasing Co content did not change the phase constitution.

Observation of γ’ precipitates in the interdendritic region and dendrite core revealed that Co significantly influenced the size and morphology of γ’ phase. As Co content increased, the size of γ’ precipitates gradually decreased in both interdendritic regions and dendrite cores. Moreover, the sphericity of γ’ precipitates progressively improved with increasing Co content.
